metadata.description: سَرْد: narrative step-by-step explanations for texts, slides, books and articles.

plugins.name: sard
plugins.description: Narrative step-by-step explanations (سرد متسلسل) from the foundation to the final meaning, in the user's language. Commands for slides with notes and handwriting, roots, whole books, articles, and slide decks.

plugins.name: sard3
plugins.description: Narrative explanations (سرد) 3.7: plain contemporary language, an explainer's voice that talks to the reader, honest connectors, functional Arabic punctuation and source fidelity; adds analysis, evaluation, comparison (sard-compare) and line-by-line commentary (sard-sharh).
